name: South Ridge Route
approach: From Marblemount, drive SR 20 east about 24 miles; just past milepost 130, before crossing the Thunder Arm of Diablo Lake, turn into Colonial Creek Campground and proceed to the Thunder Creek Trailhead at the back of the campground near the boat ramp. Hike the Thunder Creek Trail roughly 1.7-2.1 miles to the Fourth of July Pass Trail junction, then continue steeply up the west slopes about 5.2 miles total (2,629 ft gain) to Fourth of July Pass.

waypoints.name: Thunder Creek Trailhead, Colonial Creek Campground
waypoints.directions: From Marblemount, drive SR 20 east about 24 miles. Just past milepost 130, before the highway crosses the Thunder Arm of Diablo Lake, turn into Colonial Creek Campground and drive to the Thunder Creek Trailhead at the south end of the campground, at about 1,200 ft.

waypoints.name: Ruby Mountain summit
waypoints.directions: Hike the Thunder Creek Trail about 2 miles; a third of a mile past the bridge, turn left on the Fourth of July Pass Trail and climb steeply to the pass. Near a tall broken stump with old flagging, take the abandoned way trail off the north side northeast through forest, go straight up through blowdown and a rocky rib to a cairn near 4,950 ft, then follow the path up the south ridge and heather benches to open talus and the summit.
